name: P1 — Direction-specific rubric
description: P1: completeness and scientific quality under the accompanying task specification. Integrity is evaluated in the separate integrity rubric.

deliverables.title: Deliverable presence (Tier 1 gates)
deliverables.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does proposal/report.pdf exist with substantive content (full sections, not a placeholder)?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check proposal/report.pdf; open and inspect.

yes.description: Complete rendered PDF with motivation, methodology, results, analysis, conclusion.

no.description: PDF absent, empty, or placeholder.

leaves.question: Does proposal/logs/ exist with non-empty per-run records?
leaves.evidence: ls proposal/logs/; inspect a sample of files for hyperparameters, seeds, metrics, timestamps.

yes.description: Logs directory exists with per-run records.

no.description: Logs absent or essentially empty.

leaves.question: Are HIP-NN training logs present for the reimplemented baseline on the ≤8-heavy-atom QM9 subset, including at least 3 independent seeds with per-epoch training/validation MAE and final-epoch metrics?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ for HIP-NN training run records.

yes.description: Training logs present for ≥3 seeds with complete per-epoch trajectories.

no.description: Training logs absent or fewer than 3 seeds logged.

leaves.question: Are per-test-molecule output logs present for the 9-heavy-atom test set, including predicted energy, non-hierarchicality R, per-order hierarchical contributions, and any additional uncertainty signals?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ for per-molecule output records; should be one record per test molecule per seed.

yes.description: Per-molecule outputs logged completely.

no.description: Per-molecule outputs absent or incomplete (only summary statistics, no per-molecule records).

leaves.question: Is proposal/logs/paper_reference.md (or equivalent) present, listing every paper-as-reported HIP-NN value with its specific Lubbers, Smith, Barros 2018 source location (Table I / Table II / Figure N)?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check; inspect contents for specific table/figure citations.

yes.description: Audit trail for paper-as-reported values is present and specific.

no.description: No audit trail — paper-as-reported numbers cannot be verified against the source.

leaves.question: Is the main results table present in the paper, labeled tab:main_results, with two-baseline rows (paper-as-reported HIP-NN + reimplemented HIP-NN) and a 'This work' row reporting MAE + ECE + compactness K?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex search for \label{tab:main_results}.

yes.description: Table present with two-baseline structure and This-work entries.

no.description: Table absent, or missing two-baseline rows, or missing uncertainty/compactness columns.

leaves.question: Is a motif library table present in the paper, listing each identified failure motif with definition, test-set coverage, conditional error statistics, and significance support?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex for the motif table; cross-check with proposal/logs/.

yes.description: Motif library table present with the required per-motif columns.

no.description: Motif library table absent or missing required columns.

leaves.question: Is the calibration figure present (predicted-uncertainty bin vs. actual mean error, with identity line overlaid and ECE annotated)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex figures.

yes.description: Calibration figure present in the required form.

no.description: Calibration figure absent or qualitatively reported only.

leaves.question: Is the motif-compactness Pareto figure present (cumulative attribution vs. motif rank, with compactness K annotated)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex figures.

yes.description: Pareto figure present with K annotated.

no.description: Pareto figure absent or only summary-statistic reporting of compactness.

leaves.question: Does proposal/codebase_notes.md exist with substantive content documenting what was inspected and reused from the hippynn package?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check; inspect content.

yes.description: Notes document specific findings about hippynn usage.

no.description: Notes absent, empty, or token.

leaves.question: Is proposal/attempts_log.md present and substantive (when partial / unresolved work is claimed)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/attempts_log.md and proposal/report.tex to determine whether partial work is described.

tiers.name: not_required_no_partial_work
tiers.description: Paper claims no partial work; attempts log not required.

tiers.name: required_and_present_substantive
tiers.description: Partial work claimed; attempts log documents multiple distinct approaches with reasoning.

tiers.name: required_and_present_thin
tiers.description: Partial work claimed; attempts log present but documents fewer than two distinct approaches or lacks reasoning.

tiers.name: required_and_missing
tiers.description: Partial work claimed but attempts log is absent or empty.

method_specification.title: Methodology specification
method_specification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Are the motif-identification methodology, uncertainty model definition, and calibration protocol fully stated in Methodology before any empirical results are described?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section ordering.

yes.description: Methodology fully specifies all three components before Results.

no.description: One or more components stated only after empirical results, or incompletely in Methodology.

leaves.question: Is the motif-identification methodology specified completely enough that a reader could reproduce it?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology section: clustering approach, structural descriptors, classifier (if any), motif-definition criteria.

tiers.name: complete
tiers.description: Methodology fully specified — exact features used, exact criteria for motif assignment, exact significance thresholds. A reader could reproduce.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Major methodological choices stated but some details (e.g., exact clustering hyperparameters, specific descriptor formulas) require consulting the code.

tiers.name: qualitative_only
tiers.description: Methodology described in prose without specific algorithmic content.

leaves.question: Is the uncertainty model specified with precise mathematical/algorithmic definition?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology section: how predicted uncertainty is computed from R and/or other signals.

tiers.name: complete
tiers.description: Uncertainty model has precise formula or algorithm; all input signals defined.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Most components specified but some combination logic or weighting is qualitative.

tiers.name: qualitative_only
tiers.description: Uncertainty model described without precise formulation — uses R, but how is left vague.

leaves.question: Is the calibration protocol specified completely (binning approach, ECE / MCE / equivalent definition, precision/recall thresholds)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology / Experimental Setup.

tiers.name: complete
tiers.description: Binning, calibration metric, and operating thresholds all specified precisely.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Most details stated; one or two protocol elements left implicit.

tiers.name: qualitative_only
tiers.description: Calibration protocol described in prose without precise binning / metric definitions.

leaves.question: Are the HIP-NN architecture and training hyperparameters specified in the paper, with values matching the held-fixed clause (N_interaction=2, N_on-site=3, N_feature=80, λ_R=1e-2, λ_L2=1e-6, Adam with paper's settings, minibatch 30)?
leaves.evidence: Methodology / Experimental Setup; cross-check against proposal/code/.

yes.description: Architecture and protocol stated matching paper's held-fixed values.

no.description: Architecture or training protocol differs from paper without disclosure.

leaves.question: Is the methodology's motivation grounded in the published MLIP uncertainty / explainability / interpretability literature?
leaves.evidence: Methodology and Related Work sections; bibliography.

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: Method positioned against published MLIP-uncertainty work (ensemble UQ, Bayesian / dropout UQ, conformal prediction for molecules), including post-2018 developments; positioning is specific and well-cited.

tiers.name: moderate
tiers.description: Some literature referenced; positioning is shallow or uneven.

tiers.name: thin
tiers.description: Few citations beyond the source paper; motif methodology presented as if standalone.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: No engagement with relevant uncertainty / interpretability literature.

two_baseline_reporting.title: Two-baseline reporting
two_baseline_reporting.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the main results table have a row labeled (or equivalent to) 'HIP-NN (paper as reported)' with values cited to specific tables in Lubbers, Smith, Barros 2018?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex main results table.

yes.description: Paper-as-reported row present with cited values (primary references: Table I, 110k-train: 0.256 ± 0.003; 50k-train: 0.354 ± 0.004).

no.description: Paper-as-reported row absent from the main results table.

leaves.question: Does the main results table have a row labeled (or equivalent to) 'HIP-NN (reimplemented)' with values from the agent's own hippynn runs on the ≤8-heavy-atom QM9 subset?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex main results table.

yes.description: Reimplemented HIP-NN row present with logged values.

no.description: Reimplemented row absent from the main results table.

leaves.question: Are paper-as-reported HIP-NN values cited to specific tables in Lubbers, Smith, Barros 2018?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex citations; proposal/logs/paper_reference.md audit trail.

tiers.name: all_cited
tiers.description: Every paper-as-reported value has a specific source citation (e.g., 'Table I, row 110,426').

tiers.name: mostly_cited
tiers.description: Most paper-as-reported values are specifically cited; a small number have generic references.

tiers.name: generic_citation
tiers.description: Paper-as-reported values present but citations are generic ('see Lubbers et al.') rather than to specific tables.

tiers.name: uncited
tiers.description: Paper-as-reported values present but lack any citation, or the audit trail is absent.

leaves.question: How close is the reimplemented HIP-NN on the ≤8-heavy-atom subset to the paper-as-reported HIP-NN MAE on comparable training size (the paper's QM9 110k-train: 0.256 kcal/mol; or QM9 50k-train: 0.354 kcal/mol — pick the closer reference)?
leaves.evidence: Compare reimplemented HIP-NN MAE on the in-distribution test set (or held-out validation MAE at convergence) against the cited paper-as-reported numbers, adjusted for the smaller training subset.

tiers.name: close_match
tiers.description: Reimplemented MAE matches paper-as-reported within ~10% on comparable training size (adjusting for the subset size where appropriate).

tiers.name: modest_under_convergence
tiers.description: MAE is 10-25% above the comparable reference. This describes the gap and does not establish the separate reproduction floor.

tiers.name: substantial_under_convergence
tiers.description: Reimplemented MAE is substantially off paper-as-reported (25-100% higher), suggesting under-converged training or hyperparameter gaps.

tiers.name: no_match
tiers.description: MAE is more than twice the comparable reference or qualitatively inconsistent with it. Assess the scientific gap, not the agent's honesty.

baseline_verification.title: Baseline verification
baseline_verification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Are the HIP-NN reimplementation's training and validation runs documented with the declared heavy-atom partition, training-set size, and execution records? Assess run/documentation completeness here; actual training on the reserved nine-heavy-atom test cases is assessed only in integrity.
leaves.evidence: Inspect training/validation run records and dataset-size/partition documentation. The integrity partition check exclusively assesses prohibited held-out-data use.

yes.description: The reimplementation's training and validation runs, partition definition, and training-set size are documented.

no.description: The reimplementation runs or their partition/size documentation are absent or incomplete.

leaves.question: Does the actual trained HIP-NN use the task's held-fixed architecture and training protocol? Grade scientific compliance independently of disclosure.
leaves.evidence: proposal/code/ HIP-NN configuration; proposal/logs/ for per-run hyperparameter records.

tiers.name: all_respected
tiers.description: All task-required architecture/training settings are respected.

tiers.name: partial_deviation
tiers.description: At least one required setting differs, but the model remains recognizably the required HIP-NN setup.

tiers.name: wholesale_different
tiers.description: The implemented model/protocol substantially departs from the held-fixed HIP-NN setup.

tiers.name: not_established
tiers.description: The actual configuration cannot be established from the artifacts.

experimental_completeness.title: Experimental completeness
experimental_completeness.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Were at least three independent HIP-NN training seeds/shuffles completed at the held-fixed architecture, as required by the task? Report the actual count; additional seeds are encouraged but are not required to meet this minimum.
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ for per-seed run records.

tiers.name: three_or_more_seeds
tiers.description: At least three independent completed seeds/shuffles; the stated seed-count minimum is met. Five or eight seeds are not required for this node's full compliance.

tiers.name: two_seeds
tiers.description: Two completed independent seeds; below the stated minimum, even if the reduction is disclosed.

tiers.name: one_seed
tiers.description: One completed seed; below the stated minimum.

tiers.name: no_completed_seeds
tiers.description: No completed seed is evidenced.

leaves.question: Was the full provided nine-heavy-atom QM9 test subset evaluated after the task-specified pruning, rather than an arbitrary subset? Use the actual retained dataset inventory, not an extra 100,000-molecule cutoff.
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ for evaluation record counts; cross-check against expected QM9 9-heavy-atom count.

yes.description: Full 9-heavy-atom test set evaluated.

no.description: The required retained test subset is not fully evaluated, irrespective of disclosure.

leaves.question: Was the motif-assignment logic applied to all evaluated test molecules so motif coverage and conditional error distributions are computed over the full sample?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ for motif-assignment records; coverage should sum to ≤1 over the motif set with overlap noted.

yes.description: Motif assignment applied to all evaluated test molecules.

no.description: Motif assignment applied to only a subset, or non-overlapping coverage not verified.

reimplementation_accuracy.title: Reimplementation accuracy
reimplementation_accuracy.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the reimplemented HIP-NN's test MAE meet the strict contract floor: at or below the paper-as-reported MAE at the comparable training-set size (with reasonable extrapolation across training-size differences between the agent's ≤8-heavy-atom subset and the paper's full-QM9 training sizes)? The Lubbers, Smith, Barros 2018 reference points are Table I: 50k-train → 0.354 ± 0.004 kcal/mol; 100k-train → 0.261 ± 0.002; 110k-train → 0.256 ± 0.003.
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex main results table; proposal/logs/ for per-seed final MAEs. Compare against the paper's Table I MAE at the closest training-set size to the agent's actual N_train.

tiers.name: matches_or_better
tiers.description: Reimplemented HIP-NN MAE is at or below paper-as-reported at every comparable training-set size — failure motifs are anchored on a faithful baseline. The substantial outcome.

tiers.name: slight_gap_within_5_percent
tiers.description: Reimplemented MAE is within 5% above paper-as-reported. The reimplementation is close to faithful but not strictly matching.

tiers.name: modest_gap_5_to_25_percent
tiers.description: MAE is more than 5% and at most 25% above the comparable reference, irrespective of disclosure; a weaker reproduction can affect motif interpretation.

tiers.name: large_gap_25_to_100_percent
tiers.description: MAE is more than 25% and at most 100% worse than the comparable paper-as-reported value, irrespective of disclosure.

tiers.name: catastrophic_gap_above_100_percent
tiers.description: MAE is more than twice the comparable reference. The severely weak reproduction undermines scientific interpretation, irrespective of disclosure.

conformational_transfer.title: Conformational transfer of the motif library
conformational_transfer.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: How substantively does the submission address the conformational transfer of the motif library?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex conformational transfer section; proposal/logs/ for transfer-test run records.

tiers.name: substantive_on_ani1x
tiers.description: Transfer test executed on ANI-1x (the canonical conformationally-varying dataset used by that research group) with per-motif transfer-rate analysis: which motifs transfer cleanly to MD-sampled conformations and which don't. Statistical support reported. Explicit discussion of motif-library downstream usability on non-minimized geometries.

tiers.name: substantive_on_rmd17
tiers.description: Transfer test executed on rMD17 (smaller-scope alternative) with per-motif transfer-rate analysis. Acceptable scope reduction if compute pressure precluded ANI-1x integration, but the analysis is narrower in chemistry coverage.

tiers.name: partial_transfer_test
tiers.description: Transfer test attempted but with limitations — e.g., only on a subset of motifs, or only an aggregate transfer rate without per-motif analysis, or only qualitative discussion of which motifs transfer.

tiers.name: analytical_discussion_only
tiers.description: No transfer test executed; the limitation is addressed analytically by discussing how minimized-geometry training affects motif generality, with specific predictions about which motifs would or wouldn't transfer. The contract floor.

tiers.name: perfunctory_discussion
tiers.description: Limitation mentioned in the Limitations section without substantive analytical engagement.

tiers.name: not_addressed
tiers.description: Conformational transfer / minimized-geometry limitation not addressed in any form.

failure_motif_identification.title: Failure motif identification
failure_motif_identification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: How many distinct failure motifs are identified, and how broad is the chemistry they span?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex motif library table.

tiers.name: substantial_breadth
tiers.description: ≥5 motifs identified spanning multiple chemistry categories (structural / conformational / electronic / functional-group), each with quantitative statistical support.

tiers.name: modest_breadth
tiers.description: 3-4 motifs identified with statistical support; may cluster within a single chemistry category.

tiers.name: minimal_threshold
tiers.description: Exactly 3 motifs identified (the contract floor).

tiers.name: below_threshold
tiers.description: Fewer than 3 motifs identified, or some motifs lack statistical support.

leaves.question: Does each motif have quantitative statistical support (test-set coverage, conditional error distribution, significance test vs. non-matching molecules)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex motif table; proposal/logs/ for per-motif statistics.

tiers.name: rigorous
tiers.description: Each motif has: coverage, conditional error mean+percentiles, significance test (e.g., Welch's t-test or KS test) vs. non-matching molecules with stated p-values.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Coverage and conditional error reported but significance testing absent or informal.

tiers.name: qualitative
tiers.description: Motifs described with only summary error claims and no per-motif statistics.

leaves.question: Are motif definitions precise enough that a reader could apply them to a new molecule?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex motif definitions; proposal/code/ motif-assignment logic.

tiers.name: precisely_operationalized
tiers.description: Each motif has a precise structural definition (e.g., 'molecule contains a 5-membered ring with ≥2 heteroatoms') that can be coded as a deterministic check.

tiers.name: mostly_operationalized
tiers.description: Most motifs have precise definitions; a few are described qualitatively.

tiers.name: qualitative_descriptions
tiers.description: Motifs described in prose without precise structural criteria.

uncertainty_calibration.title: Uncertainty model calibration
uncertainty_calibration.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: How well does the calibration curve approach identity (predicted-uncertainty bin midpoint matching actual mean error)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex calibration figure; proposal/logs/ for bin-by-bin values.

tiers.name: close_to_identity
tiers.description: Calibration curve stays within ±10% of the identity line across the predicted-uncertainty range — substantial calibration.

tiers.name: monotonically_calibrated
tiers.description: Calibration curve monotonically increases with predicted uncertainty but deviates from identity by 10-30%.

tiers.name: weakly_calibrated
tiers.description: Calibration curve has the right monotonic trend but with significant scatter or systematic deviation.

tiers.name: miscalibrated
tiers.description: Calibration curve is flat, non-monotonic, or anti-correlated — uncertainty predictions don't track actual errors.

leaves.question: Is Expected Calibration Error (ECE) or an equivalent scalar calibration metric reported?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex calibration section.

tiers.name: ece_substantial
tiers.description: ECE reported and ≤ 0.05 — substantial calibration.

tiers.name: ece_modest
tiers.description: ECE reported and in (0.05, 0.10] — modest calibration.

tiers.name: ece_weak
tiers.description: ECE reported and > 0.10 — weak calibration.

tiers.name: ece_absent
tiers.description: ECE or equivalent scalar metric not reported.

leaves.question: Are precision and recall reported for the uncertainty model's ability to flag high-error predictions, with stated thresholds?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex calibration / failure-detection section.

tiers.name: sweep_with_chosen_operating_point
tiers.description: Precision and recall reported across a sweep of thresholds with a justified operating-point choice.

tiers.name: single_threshold
tiers.description: Precision and recall reported at one chosen threshold.

tiers.name: qualitative_only
tiers.description: Detection quality described qualitatively without precision/recall numbers.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: Precision/recall analysis absent.

motif_compactness.title: Motif compactness
motif_compactness.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the Pareto analysis demonstrate compact motif structure?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Pareto figure; proposal/logs/ for per-motif attribution.

tiers.name: substantial_compact
tiers.description: Top-K motifs (with K ≤ 5) explain ≥80% of failures — substantial compactness.

tiers.name: modest_compact
tiers.description: Top-K motifs (with K ≤ 5) explain 60-80% of failures, or top-K ≤ 8 explains ≥80%.

tiers.name: diluted
tiers.description: More than 8 motifs needed to explain ≥80% of failures — diluted failure modes.

tiers.name: no_pareto_analysis
tiers.description: Pareto-style attribution analysis absent.

mechanism_analysis.title: Mechanism analysis
mechanism_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit subsection on mechanism (why do the identified motifs produce hierarchy failure)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section structure.

yes.description: Mechanism subsection present.

no.description: No explicit mechanism subsection.

leaves.question: How deeply does the mechanism analysis connect motif structure to the HIP-NN architecture's behaviour?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex mechanism subsection.

tiers.name: strong
tiers.description: Each motif is connected mechanistically to specific aspects of the hierarchy (e.g., which n orders fail to decay; what structural environment produces the failure); the discussion ties to many-body-expansion theory or to HIP-NN's specific architectural choices.

tiers.name: moderate
tiers.description: Mechanism discussion present but explanations are partial or do not span all motifs.

tiers.name: shallow
tiers.description: Mechanisms described qualitatively without quantitative or architectural connection.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: Mechanism analysis missing or perfunctory.

failure_analysis.title: Failure analysis
failure_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit failure-analysis subsection?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section structure.

yes.description: Failure-analysis subsection present.

no.description: No dedicated failure-analysis subsection.

leaves.question: Does the failure analysis address which test molecules are not captured by any motif and what that suggests?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex failure-analysis subsection.

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: Uncovered molecules characterized quantitatively (how many, what fraction of failures they represent, what they have in common).

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: Uncovered molecules mentioned but not quantitatively characterized.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: Failure analysis does not address uncovered molecules.

leaves.question: Does the failure analysis address where the uncertainty model itself fails — false positives (high predicted uncertainty, low actual error) and false negatives (low predicted uncertainty, high actual error)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex failure-analysis subsection.

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: Both false-positive and false-negative cases characterized with examples and a connection to the model's assumptions.

tiers.name: partial
tiers.description: One of false-positive / false-negative addressed but not both.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: Uncertainty-model failures not addressed.

compute_cost_analysis.title: Computational cost analysis
compute_cost_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit computational-cost discussion?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section structure.

yes.description: Cost discussion present.

no.description: Cost discussion absent.

leaves.question: Is per-seed HIP-NN training wall-clock reported, plus per-test-molecule cost for uncertainty + motif evaluation?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex cost discussion.

yes.description: Wall-clock numbers reported for both training and evaluation.

no.description: Wall-clock not reported or only training reported.

originality_and_literature.title: Originality and literature engagement
originality_and_literature.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the proposed uncertainty model + motif methodology original relative to the published MLIP-uncertainty literature? Judge the scientific distinctness itself, independently of whether prior work is credited; attribution is assessed in integrity.
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex methodology and related-work sections.

tiers.name: distinct_contribution
tiers.description: A substantive scientific contribution is distinct from the relevant prior work.

tiers.name: meaningful_extension
tiers.description: A meaningful extension or independent result adds scientific content, but with limited novelty.

tiers.name: substantive_replication
tiers.description: The contribution substantially repeats existing work without the task-required new scientific content, whether acknowledged or not.

tiers.name: not_established
tiers.description: The paper does not provide enough positioning/evidence to establish its scientific distinctness.

leaves.question: How substantively does the paper engage with the published MLIP-uncertainty / interpretability literature (given that internet search is permitted)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex related-work section and bibliography.

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: Paper engages with the published MLIP-uncertainty literature (ensemble UQ, Bayesian / dropout UQ, conformal prediction for molecules), including post-2018 developments; positioning is specific and well-cited.

tiers.name: moderate
tiers.description: Several relevant works cited but engagement is uneven; some obvious literature missed.

tiers.name: thin
tiers.description: Few citations beyond the source paper; literature search appears shallow given that internet was available.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: Paper cites only the source paper or no literature beyond it.

leaves.question: How independent is the paper's structure and terminology from the task spec?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex title, section structure, terminology.

tiers.name: fully_independent
tiers.description: Paper reads as a self-contained journal contribution; no spec terminology leaks.

tiers.name: mostly_independent
tiers.description: Paper is largely self-contained; a few minor spec-language leaks.

tiers.name: partial_transliteration
tiers.description: Sections, terminology, or framing visibly transliterate the spec.

tiers.name: extensive_transliteration
tiers.description: Paper structure mirrors the spec wholesale.

writing_quality.title: Writing quality
writing_quality.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper read as a journal-quality contribution in structure and prose?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex main-body sections.

tiers.name: journal_quality
tiers.description: Full paragraphs, coherent narrative, appropriate use of figures and tables.

tiers.name: acceptable
tiers.description: Some structural issues (heavy bullet lists, fragments, uneven prose) but readable.

tiers.name: below_standard
tiers.description: Substantially below journal standards — bullet-list heavy, fragmented, or unedited LLM-style enumeration.

leaves.question: Is an explicit, substantive limitations discussion present and adequate for evaluating the work's scientific scope? Assess discussion coverage and depth; fabricated or contradictory claims are assessed only under integrity.
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex limitations section or Conclusion paragraph.

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: The limitations are explicitly discussed with task-relevant substance.

tiers.name: perfunctory
tiers.description: A discussion is present but superficial.

tiers.name: absent
tiers.description: The required discussion is absent.

leaves.question: Is the rendered PDF free of formatting issues (overflows, broken refs, missing figures)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.pdf inspection.

tiers.name: clean
tiers.description: PDF renders without obvious errors.

tiers.name: minor_issues
tiers.description: Some formatting issues (overflows, minor table issues, small ref problems).

tiers.name: major_issues
tiers.description: Significant rendering problems (broken refs, missing figures, overflowing equations throughout).

leaves.question: Does the paper use the provided NeurIPS LaTeX style file?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex preamble.

yes.description: neurips.sty is included.

no.description: Different style file or no formal style.

contract_checks.title: Scientific and completeness checks moved from integrity
contract_checks.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Where multiple hypotheses support inferential claims, is family-wise error controlled over the relevant hypothesis family, including outcome-dependent selection? BH-FDR alone, preregistration alone, and descriptive effect-size reporting alone do not satisfy an applicable family-wise inference requirement.
leaves.evidence: Inspect the plan, attempts log, full tested/selected hypothesis family, analysis code, adjusted inference, and claimed conclusions. Accept Holm, Bonferroni, or another valid family-wise procedure under its assumptions. Check fresh-validation independence and whether multiple confirmatory hypotheses are tested. Do not invent a correction requirement for a genuinely single prespecified test or purely descriptive claims; do not waive separately required inferential evidence.

satisfied.description: All applicable family-wise inference requirements are met.
satisfied.criteria: Document the hypothesis family, significance level, valid correction procedure, and handling of selection. Preregistration or BH-FDR alone is insufficient where family-wise control is required. Independent fresh validation still needs applicable multiplicity control across multiple confirmatory hypotheses.

not_satisfied.description: An applicable family-wise requirement is unmet.
not_satisfied.criteria: Inferential claims rely on uncorrected multiple tests, BH-FDR alone, a preregistration exemption, or descriptive effect sizes substituted for required corrected evidence, or the procedure fails to account for relevant selection. Disclosure does not make this scientifically compliant and does not by itself establish deception.

insufficient_evidence.description: The submitted evidence cannot establish whether the applicable scientific requirement is satisfied. This is not a pass and is not an integrity finding.

not_applicable.description: No multiple-testing adjustment is applicable to the actual inference.
not_applicable.criteria: Affirmatively establish a genuinely single prespecified test without unaccounted outcome-dependent selection, or purely descriptive reporting where no inferential evidence is required by the task. A small preregistered family of multiple tests is not exempt. Do not waive a required inferential result merely because it was omitted.

leaves.question: For partial, failed, or unresolved work, are the task-required attempt records present, substantive, and linked to available execution evidence? Assess documentation coverage, not whether missing evidence proves a fabricated attempt.
leaves.evidence: Inspect proposal/attempts_log.md, the associated run records, and the task's effort-evidence requirement. Require the number and distinctness of attempts stated in that task, including at least two where explicitly required; a task that says multiple distinct attempts does not introduce a minimum of three. No partial/unresolved work makes a conditional attempt requirement inapplicable.

satisfied.criteria: Affirmatively establish every applicable component of the question from the submitted evidence and the task. Use the task's actual numerical thresholds and allowed alternatives; absence of a demonstrated problem is not sufficient.

leaves.question: Are motifs defined independently of held-out test errors, or, when discovered from test errors, evaluated using the task-permitted separate holdout or stated post-selection inference? Assess validity of the statistical design; concealment of the discovery procedure is an integrity question.

Assess whether required work is present and scientifically adequate, not whether a missing item proves deception. Separate-holdout and valid post-selection routes remain available, but neither waives the applicable family-wise requirement assessed in contract.motif_significance_correction.multiple_testing_addressed.

assessment_policy.scope: Completeness and scientific quality only: required artifacts, executed experimental coverage, reproducible methodology, mathematical/statistical validity, performance targets, and task-required analysis/writing.
assessment_policy.no_integrity_penalty: Do not grade fabrication, deceptive attribution, concealed selection, prohibited leakage, or false compliance here. Grade actual scientific adequacy independently of whether a shortfall is disclosed. Integrity evidence is assessed only in integrity_check_rubric.json.
assessment_policy.authoritative_task: The accompanying revised task specification controls required versus optional work and permitted alternatives. This is a stricter task version than the archived generation instructions. Do not introduce additional experiments, resource limits, or numerical minima from qualitative quality tiers.
assessment_policy.conditional_nodes: Respect applicability. Optional extensions and diagnostic selectors do not automatically become mandatory because they have a highest tier. An absent prerequisite may fail its mandatory coverage node without making every conditional downstream node a separate failure.
assessment_policy.inference: Insufficient scientific support is not itself dishonesty. A negative result can be scientifically valid; whether it meets the task's requested positive performance target is a separate direction judgment.
